snippet.title: Slime Management Reveal | Mod Direct Mini Trailer
snippet.description:
Play as Bow Kid with Monty by her side, and save the planet from a very slimy threat in this sequel to Maintenance Management! After having all her timepieces stolen again, Bow Kid sets out on a brand new adventure to find them, but little did she know this was going to be her most dangerous adventure yet... 
Collect 80 (yes, really) Slimepieces through tons of differently themed Slime Rifts, can you collect them all?? Wait what even are Slimepieces??? I'm so confused!
Will you be able to figure out what happened to all the Timepieces? Find out when Slime Management releases, eventually!

Music in the trailer:
A Hat in Time: Her Spaceship (various variations)
Splatoon 3: Nine Out of Tension

Credits:
Mod creator: CatCube.
Rift block modeler: DanielCNR.

Follow the developer of this mod here: https://bsky.app/profile/catcube.bsky.social
